introHtml: Green is the natural color of the course, making custom green golf divot tools a seamless fit for any tournament or corporate outing. Whether you choose a simple plastic divot tool or a deluxe golf kit in a pouch, matching your brand color to the turf creates a cohesive look that golfers appreciate. Add your logo with pad printing or laser engraving for a polished finish.
